From Wiktionary, the free dictionary

English

[edit]
This entry needs quotations to illustrate usage. If you come across any interesting, durably archived quotes, then please add them!

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Spanish despedida.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • (Philippines) IPA(key): /d̪ɛs.pɛˈd̪i.d̪ɐ/
  • Audio (Philippines):(file)

Noun

[edit]

despedida (plural despedidas)

  1. (Philippines) a farewell party
    Synonym: despedida party

Derived terms

[edit]
  • despedida party

Portuguese

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
 
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /des.peˈd͡ʒi.dɐ/, /d͡ʒis.peˈd͡ʒi.dɐ/
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /des.peˈd͡ʒi.dɐ/, /d͡ʒis.peˈd͡ʒi.dɐ/
    • (Rio de Janeiro) IPA(key): /deʃ.peˈd͡ʒi.dɐ/, /d͡ʒiʃ.peˈd͡ʒi.dɐ/
    • (Southern Brazil) IPA(key): /des.peˈd͡ʒi.da/
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /dɨʃ.pɨˈdi.dɐ/ [dɨʃ.pɨˈði.ðɐ]

Adjective

[edit]

despedida f sg

  1. feminine singular of despedido

Noun

[edit]

despedida f (plural despedidas)

  1. farewell

Participle

despedida f sg

Spanish

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /despeˈdida/ [d̪es.peˈð̞i.ð̞a]
  • Rhymes: -ida
  • Syllabification: des‧pe‧di‧da

Noun

[edit]

despedida f (plural despedidas)

  1. farewell
  2. farewell party
  3. (letter-writing) valediction, complimentary close

Derived terms

[edit]
  • despedida a la francesa
  • despedida de soltera
  • despedida de soltero

Related terms

[edit]
  • despedir
  • despido

Adjective

[edit]

despedida f sg

  1. feminine singular of despedido

Participle

[edit]

despedida f sg

  1. feminine singular of despedido

Further reading

Tagalog

[edit]

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • dispedida

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Spanish despedida.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • (Standard Tagalog) IPA(key): /despeˈdida/ [d̪ɛs.pɛˈd̪iː.d̪ɐ]
  • Rhymes: -ida
  • Syllabification: des‧pe‧di‧da

Noun

[edit]

despedida (Baybayin spelling ᜇᜒᜐ᜔ᜉᜒᜇᜒᜇ)

  1. farewell; parting; leave-taking
    Synonyms: pamamaalam, pagpapaalam

Derived terms

[edit]
  • despedida-de-soltera
  • padespedida
  • padespedidahan

See also

[edit]
  • paalam

Further reading

[edit]
  • “despedida”, in Pambansang Diksiyonaryo | Diksiyonaryo.ph, 2018
